name: Fuel Filter
note: Filed by part, not by system. Could defensibly sit in Fuel System — decide once, because FSC-017 and FIC-045 are already there.

name: Transmission Filter
note: Same split as FF-003: the filter is a Filters part, the service is a transmission service. TRF-011 (Transmission Fluid) is proposed as Fluids.

name: Differential Filter
note: Differential is its own family and DFF-014 goes there. Keeping the filter in Filters would put one differential service in two families.

name: PCV Valve
note: Not a filter. It is a crankcase ventilation valve that happens to be filed under Filters in the catalog. No better family exists in the 20.

name: Oil Filter
note: THE OIL CHANGE CASE. An oil filter is never sold alone; it is part of an oil change. Filed under Filters in the catalog, but coaching it as a Filters gap would coach the wrong conversation.

name: Engine Oil Service
note: The catalog files this under Fluids, but Oil Change is its own coachable family and this is its code. Category is wrong here, name is right.

name: Coolant Flush
note: Belts & Cooling is about belts, hoses and the water pump — the hardware. This is the fluid. Split is deliberate; confirm it is what Mitch means.

name: Brake Quiet
note: NOTE: BFF-012 is Brake Fluid Flush and BFF-013 is Brake Quiet — two unrelated services one digit apart, sharing a prefix that reads as 'brake fluid'. Worth renaming.

name: Differential Fluid
note: Differential is its own coachable family; the fluid IS the service.

name: Transfer Case Fluid
note: Driveline, so Differential is arguable. Filed with the other fluid exchanges.

name: Washer Fluid Top-Off
note: Wipers is arguable — it is windshield work and rides with a blade sale. Filed as a fluid because that is what it is.

name: Windshield Treatment
note: A glass treatment rather than a wiper part, but it is sold in the same conversation.

name: Wheel Alignment
note: Alignment is its own coachable family. Category says Tires; the family list disagrees and the family list wins.

name: TPMS Service
note: NOTE: shares its prefix with TPS-050 Tire Pressure Check. Two different services, three letters apart. Worth renaming one.

name: Alternator Test
note: Charging system rather than the battery itself. The family is named Battery and has no electrical sibling, so this is the only home.

name: Bulb Replacement
note: Lighting is its own family (0054). Category files it under electrical; the family list is more specific and wins.

name: Throttle Body Clean
note: Air side rather than fuel side, but it is sold as part of the induction-service conversation with FIC-045.

name: Engine Flush
note: An engine flush is an oil-change add-on and is never sold alone. Fluids is arguable. Whichever family it lands in is where the advisor gets coached to sell it.

name: AC Recharge
note: HVAC is content-gated today (zero cues). The A/C HVAC re-import is what turns it on.

name: Tire Pressure Check
note: Filed under Engine & Performance in the catalog, which looks like a data-entry slip. See the TPS-026 prefix collision.

name: Charge Port Cleaner
note: NO FAMILY EXISTS. Would need a new family — proposed name: 'EV & Hybrid'. This is a decision about the family list, not the mapping.

name: Rodent Deterrent
note: Not EV-specific in practice. Accessories is never coached, which may be the right answer for this one.

name: Oil Change Menu — Basic
note: MENUS ARE BUNDLES, NOT SERVICES. See the note in the report: recommend excluding all eleven from the loop rather than mapping them.

name: Oil Change Menu — Preferred
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: Oil Change Menu — Premium
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: Tire & Brake Menu
note: Menu bundle spanning TWO families (Tires & Rotation and Brake Service). Cannot map to one.

name: Engine Performance Menu
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: Cooling System Menu
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: AC Service Menu
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: Transmission Service Menu
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-001.

name: Seasonal Prep — Winter
note: Menu bundle spanning several families. Maintenance is the catch-all, which is not a coachable family.

name: Seasonal Prep — Summer
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-009.

name: High Mileage Menu
note: Menu bundle — see MNU-009.

name: AC Evaporator Cleaning
note: CANDIDATE FOR THE EVC-007 ALIAS — see the report.

name: Arctic Blast
note: CANDIDATE FOR THE ABL-006 ALIAS — same service, already in the catalog.

name: Diesel Particulate Filter Service
note: NO FAMILY FITS. An emissions service, not a filter sale. Would need a new family or an explicit exclusion.

name: Accessories
note: Accessories maps and reports but is never coached, by design (lib/dms/mapping.ts).

name: Multi-Point Inspection
note: Maps cleanly by name, but MPI is the PROCESS that generates every other sale rather than a service sold against a benchmark. Coaching it as a family may not behave like the other nineteen.

name: Oil Additive
note: Rides an oil change; same reasoning as OF-008 and EFL-046.

name: Hybrid / EV Maintenance
note: NO FAMILY EXISTS — same decision as CPC-051. Proposed name: 'EV & Hybrid'. The EV Hybrid knowledge tab has 89 draft rows waiting on it.
